params.description: Hetionet metaedge code preserved on an imported relation entity.

params.name: Unbiased
params.description: Whether the Hetionet source marked the imported relation as unbiased.

params.name: Import batch
params.description: Named import batch used to group a Disease Atlas publishing wave.

params.name: Evidence category
params.description: Human-readable evidence category, for example cooccurrence, expression, or curated indication.

params.name: Source family
params.description: Original Hetionet source family recorded on an imported claim.

params.name: Log2 fold change
params.description: STARGEO disease-gene expression effect size preserved from Hetionet.

params.name: Associated genes
params.description: Links a disease to genes associated with the condition in curated Disease Atlas imports.

params.name: Participates in pathway
params.description: Links a gene to a pathway annotation included in a Hetionet-derived disease packet.

params.name: Participates in biological process
params.description: Links a gene to a GO-style biological process annotation included in Disease Atlas.

params.name: Has molecular function
params.description: Links a gene to a GO-style molecular function annotation included in Disease Atlas.

params.name: Located in cellular component
params.description: Links a gene to a GO-style cellular component annotation included in Disease Atlas.

params.name: Includes drug
params.description: Links a drug class to a drug membership relation preserved from Hetionet pharmacologic class imports.

params.name: Presents symptom evidence
params.description: Evidence-only relation linking a disease to a symptom observed by Hetionet source evidence.

params.name: Localizes to anatomy evidence
params.description: Evidence-only relation linking a disease to anatomical context observed by Hetionet source evidence.

params.name: Resembles disease evidence
params.description: Evidence-only relation linking a disease to another disease through Hetionet disease-similarity evidence.

params.name: Upregulates
params.description: Evidence-only regulation relation indicating the source entity is associated with increased activity or expression of the target entity. The current STARGEO imports target genes, but the predicate is intentionally reusable across entity types.

params.name: Downregulates
params.description: Evidence-only regulation relation indicating the source entity is associated with decreased activity or expression of the target entity. The current STARGEO imports target genes, but the predicate is intentionally reusable across entity types.

params.name: Palliates disease
params.description: Evidence-only PharmacotherapyDB relation where a compound palliates rather than treats a disease.
